items.abstract: <jats:p>This paper is an exploratory and descriptive study. The author makes no claims of causality or exploitability regarding the documented patterns. We present an exploratory study of the post-breakout sequence in the Invesco QQQ Trust ETF, using intraday data at one-minute resolution from January 2017 through December 2024. The existing literature on the Opening Range Breakout focuses on entry at the moment of the breakout; the internal dynamics of the minutes that follow have not been measured to date. items.title: Assessing the Profitability of Timely Opening Range Breakout on Index Futures Markets
Regime-Conditional Alpha in SPY 0DTE Opening Range Breakout Strategies: A Filtering and Strike Selection Framework
items.abstract: <jats:p>This paper presents a simulation-based quantitative examination of the Opening Range Breakout (ORB) strategy applied to zero-days-to-expiration (0DTE) debit vertical spreads on the SPDR S&amp;P 500 ETF Trust (SPY). Using a transparent Monte Carlo simulation framework calibrated to empirically documented parameters across 756 potential trading days (2022-2025), we model 214 filtered trades and derive the conditions under which the strategy generates positive expected value.
